---
name: review-bounded-completion
description: Run a focused independent review of the active bounded completion task.
agent: 'Bounded Completion Reviewer'
---

# Purpose

Review the active task contract, durable state, findings, latest verification evidence, and current Git diff. Challenge assumptions, test coverage, failure handling, security boundaries, incomplete integration, disabled or weakened validation, placeholders, and stale evidence. Inspect real visual artifacts when visual criteria apply. Return only evidence-backed structured findings or explicitly labeled hypotheses; distinguish blockers from suggestions and do not reopen resolved findings without materially new evidence.
